input.summary: Kovai Finechem (V01, contact R. Selvam, Sales). Sent offer in their own ERP format (accepted by us) and a COA for propanediol only. Latest reply: glycerin (RM-002) density is 1.26 g/mL at 25C, so the litre quote can be converted to kg. Still open, asked in our 6-point clarification: COA for each line (knockout, B5), SDS with transport class (knockout, H1), selling-unit-to-kg conversion for each line (C2), strength/assay and method for each line (B2), need-by 20 Dec 2026 (E3), OTIF last 12 months with definition (I1). Density for other liquids still needed (C3). No open issues in the rule engine. Response deadline 14 Nov 2026. Next step: consolidated reminder with numbered questions.

input.subject: RE: RFx KPC-2026-014 - Thank you for glycerin density, remaining items
input.body:
Dear Mr. Selvam,

Thank you for the glycerin density (1.26 g/mL at 25C). This lets us convert the RM-002 quote to kilograms.

To complete our evaluation, please answer the following by 14 November 2026:

1. Certificate of Analysis: provide a recent batch COA for each of the 10 lines, showing batch number, manufacturing date and expiry or retest date. We have the propanediol COA; the other nine are still needed.
2. Safety Data Sheet: provide the current SDS for each line, including the transport hazard class.
3. Conversion to kilograms: confirm the conversion from your selling unit to kg of net material for each line (for example, 1 L of glycerin = 1.26 kg net). A completed Annexure A also meets this requirement.
4. Density for other liquids: for RM-001, RM-004, RM-006, RM-009 and RM-010, state density in g/mL at a stated temperature.
5. Strength/assay: for each line, state the strength or assay, the marker it is measured against and the test method. Our specifications are 98% active for D-Panthenol, 500 ppm peptide for Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3 and 1,000 ppm peptide for Copper Tripeptide-1. If your strength differs, state the quantity needed to deliver the same active content.
6. Delivery: can you meet our first need-by date of 20 December 2026? If not, state your earliest date for the first delivery.
7. OTIF: state your on-time-in-full rate for these lines over the last 12 months and your definition of on-time.

Regards,
Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care
